title: WaterSound "Sunkissed" 220 Salt Box Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Private deeded beach access- 4-Passenger golf cart- Grill- Community pool- Private gated community- 4 Adult bikes- From March 1st to October 31st, 2024, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella)- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout This home permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: Sunkissed is a stunning 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home that sleeps 10 in the private gated community of WaterSound. Centrally located along the breathtaking Emerald Coast, guests will love the nearby parks, walking trails and boardwalks winding through the rolling dunes, and access to 2 community pools. With more than 2,100 square feet of living space, the stunning bedrooms, screened-in porch, and tranquil surroundings are sure to please!A delightful blue exterior surrounded by an adorable white fence welcomes guests onto this charming 2-story property. The spacious great room, showered in natural light from the windows, creates a bright and airy atmosphere. Curl up and watch TV on the comfortable furnishings in the living area, all situated around a fireplace. The dining area features a stylish combination of white rattan chairs and bench seating, complemented by a coastal light fixture overhead. An adjoining gourmet kitchen is equipped with everything needed to make a delicious meal, including granite countertops, high-end appliances, and a pantry for storage. The kitchen island doubles as a breakfast bar with 3 stools for casual dining. In the hallway, guests will find a dedicated workstation with a desk, as well as 2 comfortable guest bedrooms, each furnished with a king-sized bed and a private bathroom. Discover a charming screened-in porch just off the great room with a small patio and grill area.Indulge in pure luxury in the spacious primary bedroom on the second floor of this home with a king bed and private bathroom—the perfect retreat!Discover the ideal space for kids—or simply for relaxing—on the third floor. This loft area features 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds and a TV for entertainment. Plus, breathtaking top-floor Gulf views!Prepare to be sunkissed after leaving this incredible WaterSound home. With on-site parking—plus 4 adult bikes and a golf cart—it's easy to explore Alys, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach. Discover tranquility at one of the world's most beautiful beaches in Sunkissed. Book Sunkissed today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 10)FIRST FLOOR:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub SeparateTHIRD FLOOR:Loft Area: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk BedsWATERSOUND COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTS:-Over 250 Acre Gated Beach Community on the Gulf of Mexico between Seaside and Rosemary Beach-(2) Community Pools (Dunesider Pool in Main Gate and Bridges Pool within the Bridges Gate)-Kayak Rentals-Parks, Walking Trails and Meandering Boardwalks-Bike to Alys, Seacrest and Rosemary Beach-A short walk to The Big Chill*Please Note:*Access to the WaterSound Beach Club is not included*WaterSound does not allow golf cart rentals from outside vendors*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*The golf cart provided is not street-legal and can only be used inside of Watersound gates.

body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery WaterSound "Sunkissed" 220 Salt Box Lane Watersound, FL Short Term Rental #STR-032678 Bedrooms 4 Beds 7 Sleeps 10 Full Baths 3 Half Baths 0 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gated Community with on-site Security - Private deeded beach access - 4-Passenger golf cart - Grill - Community pool - Private gated community - 4 Adult bikes - From March 1st to October 31st, 2024, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella) - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout This home permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate. DETAILS: Sunkissed is a stunning 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home that sleeps 10 in the private gated community of WaterSound. Centrally located along the breathtaking Emerald Coast, guests will love the nearby parks, walking trails and boardwalks winding through the rolling dunes, and access to 2 community pools. With more than 2,100 square feet of living space, the stunning bedrooms, screened-in porch, and tranquil surroundings are sure to please! A delightful blue exterior surrounded by an adorable white fence welcomes guests onto this charming 2-story property. The spacious great room, showered in natural light from the windows, creates a bright and airy atmosphere. Curl up and watch TV on the comfortable furnishings in the living area, all situated around a fireplace. The dining area features a stylish combination of white rattan chairs and bench seating, complemented by a coastal light fixture overhead. An adjoining gourmet kitchen is equipped with everything needed to make a delicious meal, including granite countertops, high-end appliances, and a pantry for storage. The kitchen island doubles as a breakfast bar with 3 stools for casual dining. In the hallway, guests will find a dedicated workstation with a desk, as well as 2 comfortable guest bedrooms, each furnished with a king-sized bed and a private bathroom. Discover a charming screened-in porch just off the great room with a small patio and grill area. Indulge in pure luxury in the spacious primary bedroom on the second floor of this home with a king bed and private bathroom—the perfect retreat! Discover the ideal space for kids—or simply for relaxing—on the third floor. This loft area features 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds and a TV for entertainment. Plus, breathtaking top-floor Gulf views! Prepare to be sunkissed after leaving this incredible WaterSound home. With on-site parking—plus 4 adult bikes and a golf cart—it's easy to explore Alys, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach. Discover tranquility at one of the world's most beautiful beaches in Sunkissed. Book Sunkissed today!
